• AI Symptom Checker: Your Instant Health Analysis Assistant Vision & Purpose: The AI
Symptom Checker is one of the most powerful and innovative features of Swasthya Setu.
Its core purpose is to provide users with instant, intelligent, and evidence-based analysis
of their health symptoms. The vision for this feature is to bridge the gap between the
moment a person feels unwell and the moment they can consult a healthcare professional.
It aims to reduce anxiety by providing clear, structured information and to empower users
to have more informed conversations with their doctors. It functions as a sophisticated,
AI-powered triage assistant, helping users understand the potential severity of their
symptoms and guiding them toward the most appropriate next steps, while always
emphasizing that it is an informational tool and not a substitute for a professional medical
diagnosis.
Key Components & Functionality: The feature is designed as a simple, three-step process
to ensure ease of use while gathering the necessary information for a high-quality
analysis.
Step 1: Symptom Input: The process begins with a user-friendly interface where you can
enter your symptoms. You can type in any symptom (e.g., "headache," "fever," "cough"),
and it is added as a tag. This tag-based system allows for the input of multiple, distinct
symptoms in a clean and organized manner. The system also suggests common
symptoms to streamline the process.
Step 2: Providing Context: Once the symptoms are entered, the checker asks for crucial
context: the duration (e.g., "Less than 1 day," "1-3 days") and the severity (e.g., "mild,"
"moderate," "severe"). This step is critical because the same symptom can have vastly
different implications based on its duration and intensity. This contextual information allows
the AI to perform a much more nuanced and accurate analysis.

Step 3: AI Analysis & Results: After submitting the details, the app sends the data to a
powerful Large Language Model (LLM). The AI has been instructed to act as a medical
assistant and analyze the input based on a vast database of medical knowledge. It returns
a structured JSON object, which the app then parses and displays in a series of beautifully
designed, easy-to-read cards:
Urgency Alert: The most important result is displayed first. This is a color-coded alert (e.g.,
green for low, yellow for medium, red for high/emergency) that immediately communicates
the AI's assessment of the situation's urgency. It is accompanied by a clear statement on
when to seek care (e.g., "Monitor at home," "Consider seeing a doctor soon," "Seek
immediate medical attention"). Analysis Summary: A brief, plain-language overview of the
situation. Possible Conditions: A list of potential conditions that could be associated with
the given symptoms. This helps the user understand the range of possibilities.
Recommendations: Actionable steps the user can take, such as scheduling a doctor's
appointment or trying specific self-care measures. Self-Care Tips: Concrete suggestions
for at-home care to help alleviate the symptoms. Symptom History: On the same page, a
sidebar component displays a list of your past symptom checks. This allows you to track
patterns over time and easily reference previous analyses, which is invaluable for
monitoring chronic conditions or recurring issues.
The Technology Behind It: This feature is powered by the InvokeLLM integration. When
you click "Analyze Symptoms," the app constructs a detailed prompt that includes the list
of symptoms, duration, and severity. It also provides the AI with a strict
response_json_schema, forcing the model to return the data in a predictable format. This
ensures that the results are always consistent and can be reliably displayed in the user
interface. The disclaimer "This is not a real medical diagnosis" is included in every prompt
to ensure the AI's responses are appropriately cautious.
• Medications: Your Smart & Safe Pharmacy Companion Vision & Purpose: The
Medication Management feature is designed to be far more than a simple pill reminder. It
is a comprehensive, intelligent system built to ensure safety, improve adherence, and
empower users with knowledge about their treatments. The vision is to create a single
source of truth for a user's entire medication regimen, reducing the risk of human error,
preventing dangerous drug interactions, and providing peace of mind. It transforms the
often stressful and confusing task of managing multiple medications into a simple, safe,
and streamlined process, acting as a personal pharmacist, safety officer, and adherence
coach all in one.
Key Components & Functionality: This feature is organized into a powerful, tab-based

interface, with each tab dedicated to a specific aspect of medication management.
Overview & Medication List: This is the main dashboard, displaying all your active
medications. Each entry shows the name, dosage, and frequency. You can easily log a
dose as "taken" or "skipped." It also includes options to edit or delete a medication. The
"Add Medication" flow is comprehensive, allowing you to input details like the prescribing
doctor, the purpose of the medication, and refill information. Drug Information Search: This
AI-powered tool allows you to look up detailed information about any medication. By
simply typing in a drug's name (brand or generic), the feature uses the InvokeLLM
integration to query the OpenFDA database. It returns a wealth of information, including
what the drug is used for, dosage instructions, all listed side effects, and critical warnings,
presented in an easy-to-navigate accordion format. Medicine Image Search: A
cutting-edge safety feature. If you have a pill but are unsure what it is, you can upload a
picture of it. The app uses AI to analyze the image (checking for imprints, color, and
shape) and identify the medication, providing you with its name and details. This is
invaluable for preventing accidental medication mix-ups. Drug Interaction Checker: This is
arguably the most critical safety component. The system automatically takes all your active
medications and uses an AI model to cross-reference them for potential interactions. It
queries the OpenFDA database for known conflicts and presents the results with clear
severity levels: "minor," "moderate," "major," or "severe." For each interaction, it provides a
detailed description, explains the clinical significance, and offers recommendations, such
as "monitor for symptoms" or "avoid combination and consult your doctor." Reminders,
Adherence & Refills: This section focuses on consistency. You can set up specific
reminder times for each medication. The "Adherence" tab provides visual charts and
statistics showing your adherence rate over time, helping you stay on track. The "Refill
Manager" keeps track of your prescription quantities and reminds you when it's time to
request a refill from your doctor or pharmacy. Side Effect Tracker: This allows you to log
any side effects you experience while taking a medication. You can record the effect, its
severity, and its duration. This creates a valuable log that you can share with your doctor
to help them adjust your treatment plan if necessary. Emergency Access: This feature
prepares a concise, easy-to-read summary of your most critical medical information,
including your active medications, known allergies, and primary medical conditions. This
summary can be quickly copied or shared with emergency responders in a crisis,
potentially saving your life. User Experience: The multi-tab layout allows for immense
functionality without overwhelming the user. The consistent design language, clear
iconography, and color-coded alerts (especially in the interaction checker) make complex
information easy to digest. The entire feature is designed to instill a sense of confidence
and control, turning the user from a passive patient into an active, informed participant in

their own healthcare.

managing medical consultations. The vision extends beyond a simple booking calendar; it

healthcare providers and facilities. It's designed to eliminate the hassle of juggling different
clinic phone numbers, addresses, and appointment times. By integrating a booking flow, a
doctor directory, and a location-based hospital search into one seamless interface, this
feature empowers you to find, book, and manage your healthcare appointments with
unprecedented ease and efficiency.

each addressing a different user need.

appointment effortless. It walks you through selecting a provider, choosing an available
time slot, filling in your details (reason for visit, insurance information), and finally,
confirming the appointment. This structured process ensures all necessary information is
captured accurately, reducing back-and-forth communication with the clinic. My
Appointments: This tab serves as your personal appointment history and calendar. It
displays a list of all your upcoming and past appointments. For upcoming appointments,
you can see the provider's name, the scheduled date and time, and the location. You also

view ensures you never miss a follow-up or forget a scheduled checkup. Doctor Phone
Book: This component acts as your personal medical directory. Instead of searching
through your phone's contacts or old papers, you can save the contact details of all your
healthcare providers here. Each entry can include the doctor's name, specialty, clinic
name, phone number, and address. This makes it incredibly easy to get in touch with your
specialists, primary care physician, or therapist whenever you need to. Nearby Hospitals &
Clinics: This is a powerful, map-based search tool for finding medical care in your vicinity.
You can either enter a location (like a city or address) or use your device's GPS to find
facilities near you. The feature uses an AI model to perform a geographic search, plotting
hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies on an interactive map. Each location marker can be
clicked to reveal details like the facility's name, address, phone number, and website.
There is even a "Call" button for instant connection, which is invaluable in urgent
situations. The high-quality map interface is smooth, responsive, and easy to navigate.
User Experience: The tab-based navigation makes it simple to switch between booking a
new appointment, reviewing your schedule, or finding a new doctor. The booking flow is

designed to be foolproof, guiding you through each stage with clear instructions. The map
interface in the "Nearby Hospitals" tab is a standout feature, offering a modern, intuitive
visual search experience that is far superior to simply looking at a text-based list of
addresses. The entire module is designed to save time, reduce organizational stress, and
give you confidence in managing your healthcare logistics.

customizable: you can add your own favorite songs from YouTube to any playlist, creating

a private space where you can articulate your thoughts and receive a supportive response.
The AI is programmed to recognize signs of crisis and will direct you to professional help if
necessary. It even features an optional text-to-speech function to read the responses
aloud. Educational Resources: This section provides articles, guides, and information on
various mental health topics. It aims to educate users about mental wellness, common
conditions, and evidence-based strategies for self-care, empowering them with knowledge.

immediate access to crisis resources. It includes phone numbers for hotlines and clear
instructions on where to turn for immediate, professional help in a mental health
emergency. User Experience: The design of the Mental Health Hub is intentionally calm
and reassuring, using soft colors and a clean layout. The personalization, from the
exercise recommendations based on your mood to the customizable music playlists,
makes the feature feel deeply individual. The privacy of the journal and AI chat is
paramount, creating a safe digital space for self-reflection and support.

needs. It acts as a personal AI nutritionist, available at your fingertips to answer questions
and create a structured plan for your success.
Key Components & Functionality: The feature is organized into two main, powerful tabs:
AI Diet Planner: This is the core component for personalized nutrition planning. It is an
interactive tool where you provide the AI with key information about yourself and your
goals. The input fields include:
Age, Gender, Weight, and Height: Basic biometric data for calculating energy needs.
Activity Level: How active you are (e.g., sedentary, lightly active, very active). Dietary
Goal: What you want to achieve (e.g., "Weight Loss," "Muscle Gain," "Maintain Health").
Dietary Preferences: Your food choices (e.g., "Vegetarian," "Vegan," "Anything"). Allergies
or Dislikes: Any foods you cannot or will not eat. Once you submit this information, the
InvokeLLM integration sends it to a powerful AI model. The AI processes these details and
generates a complete, structured, 7-day diet plan. This isn't just a list of foods; it's a
detailed schedule broken down by day and meal (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snacks),

complete with portion suggestions and healthy alternatives. The plan is presented in a
clear, easy-to-read format, making it simple to follow.
About Food: This is an AI-powered food encyclopedia. It features a simple search bar
where you can type in the name of any food item—from a simple "apple" to a complex dish
like "chicken tikka masala." The AI then provides a comprehensive nutritional breakdown
of that item. The information returned includes:
Macronutrients: A detailed count of calories, protein, carbohydrates, and fats.
Micronutrients: Key vitamins and minerals present in the food. Health Benefits: A
description of how the food can contribute to your well-being. Potential Downsides: Any
health considerations to be aware of, such as high sugar content or allergens. This tool is
perfect for making on-the-spot decisions, whether you're at the grocery store or a
restaurant, allowing you to instantly understand the nutritional impact of your food choices.

Swasthya Sathi - Complete App Documentation
n App Overview
Swasthya Sathi (Health Companion) is a comprehensive AI-powered health management
platform designed to help users track, manage, and optimize their health journey. The app
features a vibrant gradient-based UI with glass-morphism design elements, providing a
modern and visually appealing experience. Built with React, it integrates advanced AI
capabilities for symptom analysis, medication tracking, mental health support, and
personalized health insights.
n UI/UX Design Philosophy
Visual Design: The app employs a stunning gradient background system with purple, pink,
rose, blue, and orange hues creating an energetic yet calming atmosphere. The design
uses glass-morphism (backdrop-blur effects with semi-transparent backgrounds)
throughout, giving cards and components a frosted glass appearance. Animated gradient
orbs float in the background, adding depth and visual interest without overwhelming the
interface.
Navigation Structure: The app features a responsive sidebar navigation on desktop (fixed
left side, 256px wide) that collapses into a mobile hamburger menu. Navigation items
include intuitive icons from Lucide React paired with clear labels. The active page is
highlighted with a white semi-transparent background and shadow effect, making
navigation state always clear.
Color System: The color palette uses CSS custom properties and Tailwind classes with
transparency layers. Primary actions use purple-to-pink gradients, success states use
green tones, warnings use orange/yellow, and critical alerts use red gradients. All colors
maintain WCAG accessibility standards with proper contrast ratios.

Responsive Design: Every component is mobile-first, using Tailwind's responsive
breakpoints (sm, md, lg, xl). Cards stack vertically on mobile and arrange in grids on larger
screens. The layout adapts seamlessly from 320px mobile screens to 4K displays, with
special attention to touch targets (minimum 44x44px) for mobile usability.
Animation & Micro-interactions: Framer Motion powers smooth page transitions, card
hover effects, and element entrances. Buttons have hover states with scale and color
transitions. Loading states use animated spinners, and success/error feedback appears
via toast notifications. All animations follow easing curves that feel natural and enhance
rather than distract from the user experience.
n Dashboard (Main Hub)
Core Functionality: The Dashboard serves as the central command center of Swasthya
Sathi, providing users with a comprehensive overview of their health status at a glance. It
aggregates data from all app modules to present a unified health score, recent activities,
upcoming appointments, medication reminders, and AI-generated health insights. The
dashboard uses a card-based layout where each card represents a different health metric
or quick action.
Health Score System: A prominent circular progress indicator displays the user's overall
health score out of 100, calculated using a weighted algorithm that considers medication
adherence (25%), symptom frequency (20%), mental health indicators (20%), appointment
attendance (15%), chronic condition management (10%), and general activity levels
(10%). The score dynamically updates as users log data throughout the app, with color
coding (green for 80+, yellow for 60-79, orange for 40-59, red below 40) providing
immediate visual feedback.
7-Day Health Trend: Below the main health score, a mini line chart visualizes the user's
health trajectory over the past week, allowing them to spot patterns and improvements.
Each data point is clickable to view that day's detailed breakdown, making it easy to
identify what contributed to score changes.
Quick Stats Grid: Four prominent stat cards display critical metrics: total active
medications, upcoming appointments in the next 7 days, recent symptom reports, and
current mood streak. Each stat is accompanied by an icon, current value, and trend
indicator (up/down arrows) compared to the previous period.

Recent Activity Feed: A chronological feed shows the last 10 health actions taken by the
user - medications logged, symptoms reported, appointments scheduled, mood entries,
etc. Each activity has a timestamp, icon, and brief description, allowing users to quickly
review their health engagement without navigating to specific modules.
Quick Actions: Large, touch-friendly buttons provide one-tap access to the most common
tasks: "Log Medication," "Check Symptoms," "Record Mood," "Book Appointment," and
"Emergency Profile." These shortcuts reduce navigation friction for daily health tracking
tasks.
AI Health Insights: A dedicated card uses the Core.InvokeLLM integration to analyze the
user's recent health data and generate personalized insights, tips, and alerts. The AI might
notice patterns like "Your symptoms seem to worsen on days when you miss your evening
medication" or "Your mood has improved 30% since starting morning walks." These
insights update weekly or when significant patterns emerge.
Advanced Alerts: The dashboard prominently displays critical health alerts like medication
expiry warnings, missed doses, upcoming appointment reminders, chronic condition
readings outside target ranges, and emergency profile updates needed. Each alert is
color-coded by urgency and actionable with one-tap buttons.
n Medications Management
Comprehensive Medication Tracking: This module is the most feature-rich part of
Swasthya Sathi, designed to eliminate medication errors and optimize treatment
adherence. Users can add medications with complete details including name, dosage
(e.g., 500mg), frequency (e.g., twice daily), prescribing doctor, purpose/indication, start
date, expiry date, total pills in pack, and current pills remaining. Each medication card
displays this information in an organized, scannable format.
Dose Logging System: Users can mark each dose as "Taken" (green button with
checkmark) or "Skipped" (red button with X). Every log is timestamped and stored in the
doses_logged array, creating a complete adherence history. The system tracks daily,
weekly, and monthly adherence rates, calculating percentages that feed into the overall
health score.
Expiry Alerts & Tracking: The ExpiryAlerts component continuously monitors all
medications' expiry dates. It categorizes them as "Critical" (expired or expiring within 7

days), "Warning" (8-30 days), or "OK" (30+ days). Each category has distinct color coding
and sorting priority. Users receive push notifications (if enabled) 30 days, 7 days, and 1
day before expiry, preventing the use of expired medications.
Smart Refill Tracker: The RefillTracker component calculates when medications will run
out based on current pills remaining, total pills, and logged dose history. It computes daily
consumption rate, estimates days until empty, and displays a visual progress bar showing
pill depletion. When supplies drop below 20%, the system sends refill reminders and
marks the medication with a "Low Stock" badge. Users can tap "Mark as Refilled" to
update counts and log refill dates.
Missed Dose Advisor: This AI-powered feature analyzes when doses were missed and
provides time-sensitive advice. If a dose is missed by less than 2 hours, it suggests "Take
now." If 2-6 hours late, it advises "Take if within safe window." If more than 6 hours or
close to the next scheduled dose, it recommends "Skip and take next dose on time." The
advice considers medication half-life and safety guidelines, with disclaimers to consult
healthcare providers for critical medications.
Drug Information Search (OpenFDA Integration): Users can search any medication by
name, and the app queries the OpenFDA database (via LLM with internet context) to
retrieve official drug information including approved uses, standard dosage guidelines,
complete side effects list, contraindications, warnings, drug interactions, and storage
requirements. Results are displayed in expandable accordion sections for easy navigation.
This feature helps users make informed decisions and understand their medications
better.
Medication Image ID (Premium Feature): This cutting-edge feature allows users to
photograph a medicine package (pill bottle, blister pack, or box) and uses AI vision to
extract printed text via OCR. The system identifies the medication name, active
ingredients, dosage form (tablet/capsule/liquid), manufacturer, batch number, expiry date,
and storage instructions. It also provides uses, side effects, and warnings. This is
invaluable when users have unlabeled medications or need to quickly identify pills. The
feature works offline-first, processing images locally when possible.
Drug Interaction Checker: When users have 2+ active medications, they can run an
interaction check. The system sends the complete medication list to OpenFDA (via LLM
with internet context) and retrieves all known drug-drug interactions. Each interaction is
rated by severity (minor/moderate/major/severe) with color coding, detailed descriptions of

what happens when drugs interact, clinical significance, and specific recommendations
(e.g., "Take 2 hours apart" or "Avoid combination - consult doctor"). This prevents
dangerous medication combinations.
Effectiveness Tracking: Users can rate each medication's effectiveness on a 1-10 scale,
noting time to relief, side effects experienced, and whether they'd take it again. The app
aggregates ratings to show average effectiveness scores, helping users and doctors
identify which treatments work best. Medications with low effectiveness scores trigger
suggestions to discuss alternatives with healthcare providers.
Side Effects Reporting: A dedicated section allows users to log side effects experienced
from any medication. They record the medication name, effect description, severity
(mild/moderate/severe), duration, and date. The app maintains a complete side effect
history, which can be exported as a PDF report for doctor visits. The system also flags
medications with repeated severe side effects for immediate medical review.
Chronic Condition Tracker: Integrated within medications, this tracks ongoing conditions
like diabetes or hypertension. Users log periodic readings (blood sugar, blood pressure,
etc.) with dates, values, and notes. The app displays trend charts showing if readings are
improving or worsening, compares readings against target ranges, and alerts when values
exceed safe thresholds. It also tracks which medications/lifestyle changes correlate with
better condition control.
n Symptom Checker
AI-Powered Symptom Analysis: The Symptom Checker is an intelligent diagnostic
assistant that helps users understand their symptoms and determine if medical attention is
needed. Users select from a comprehensive list of common symptoms (headache, fever,
nausea, chest pain, etc.) or describe custom symptoms in natural language. They specify
symptom duration (less than 1 day, 1-3 days, 3-7 days, 1-2 weeks, 2+ weeks) and severity
(mild/moderate/severe).
Intelligent Triage System: Once symptoms are entered, the AI analyzes them using
medical knowledge databases and assigns an urgency level: "Low" (self-care appropriate),
"Medium" (monitor closely, consider doctor visit), "High" (see doctor within 24-48 hours), or
"Emergency" (seek immediate medical attention). The urgency assessment considers
symptom combinations, duration, severity, and red flag symptoms that indicate serious
conditions.

Detailed Analysis Report: The AI generates a comprehensive report including a
plain-language summary of the symptoms, possible conditions that match the symptom
profile (ranked by likelihood), self-care recommendations (rest, hydration, over-the-counter
medications), specific situations requiring urgent care, and suggested specialists to consult
if symptoms persist. The analysis uses evidence-based medical guidelines but always
includes disclaimers about seeking professional medical advice.
Symptom History Tracking: All symptom checks are saved with timestamps, creating a
symptom diary. Users can view past checks to track recurring symptoms, identify patterns
(e.g., headaches every Monday), and share this history with doctors. The system
highlights symptom trends like increasing frequency or severity over time.
Specialist Routing: Based on the analysis, the system suggests appropriate medical
specialists (cardiologist for chest pain, neurologist for persistent headaches,
gastroenterologist for digestive issues, etc.). This helps users know which doctor to book
appointments with, reducing misdiagnosed referrals and saving time.
n Appointments Management
Appointment Booking System: Users can schedule medical appointments by entering
doctor name, specialty, clinic name, appointment date and time, reason for visit, location,
phone number, and insurance information. The system supports both upcoming and past
appointments, automatically moving completed appointments to history based on date.
Visual Calendar Interface: A monthly calendar view displays all scheduled appointments
with color coding by specialty. Users can click dates to view appointment details or add
new appointments directly from the calendar. The interface supports month navigation and
highlights the current date.
Doctor Directory: A built-in directory stores doctor information including name, specialty,
clinic affiliation, phone number, address, and email. Users can add doctors to their
directory and quickly select from saved doctors when booking appointments, eliminating
repetitive data entry. The directory is searchable and sortable by specialty.
Nearby Healthcare Finder: Using React-Leaflet maps and geolocation, the app displays
nearby hospitals, clinics, and healthcare facilities on an interactive map. Users can search
by location (city name or zip code) or use their current GPS position. Each facility is
marked with a red pin, and clicking reveals name, address, rating, and directions. This is

invaluable during emergencies or when traveling.
Appointment Reminders: The system sends notifications 1 day and 1 hour before
scheduled appointments, reducing missed appointments. Reminders include appointment
details, doctor name, clinic address, and an option to get directions via maps integration.
Status Tracking: Appointments can be marked as "Scheduled" (default), "Completed"
(moved to history), or "Cancelled." Completed appointments remain accessible in the
history tab with notes about visit outcomes.
n Mental Health Hub
Mood Tracking System: The Mental Health Hub recognizes that mental wellness is as
important as physical health. Users log their daily mood by selecting from five options:
"Awful" (red), "Bad" (orange), "Okay" (yellow), "Good" (light green), or "Great" (green).
Each mood is associated with an emoji for quick recognition. Mood logs include an
optional journal entry where users can elaborate on their feelings, events that influenced
their mood, or thoughts they want to process.
Activity Tagging: When logging mood, users can tag activities they did that day from a
predefined list (exercise, socializing, working, relaxing, creative activities, nature time,
etc.). Over time, the app analyzes which activities correlate with better moods, helping
users identify what genuinely improves their mental state. For example, it might reveal
"You're 40% more likely to feel good on days when you exercise."
Mood Trends & Analytics: The app displays mood history as a calendar heatmap where
each day is colored by mood. A line graph shows mood trajectory over weeks and months,
making it easy to spot patterns like seasonal affective disorder, stress periods correlated
with work deadlines, or gradual improvement with therapy/medication. Statistics show
average mood, most common mood, mood streak (consecutive good days), and total
journal entries.
Guided Mental Health Exercises: The hub offers a library of therapeutic exercises
including breathing techniques (4-7-8 breathing, box breathing), guided meditation videos,
progressive muscle relaxation, visualization exercises, and grounding techniques for
anxiety. Each exercise has a video tutorial, duration, difficulty level, and targeted benefit
(stress reduction, sleep improvement, anxiety relief, focus enhancement). The app tracks
completed exercises and suggests relevant ones based on current mood.

AI Mental Health Companion: A compassionate AI chatbot provides emotional support
through text conversation. Users can share feelings, worries, or thoughts, and the AI
responds with empathy, validation, and evidence-based coping strategies. The companion
uses motivational interviewing techniques, cognitive behavioral therapy principles, and
mindfulness-based stress reduction approaches. It's explicitly not a replacement for
professional therapy but serves as a 24/7 supportive presence. All conversations are
private and stored locally with end-to-end encryption.
Music Therapy Integration: Music has profound effects on mental health, so the app
includes a curated music library organized by emotional need. Categories include
"Adrenaline/High Energy" (workout music, upbeat tracks), "Adrenaline Raps" (motivational
hip-hop), "Peace/Calm with Vocals" (acoustic, folk, soothing songs), "Peace/Instrumental"
(classical, ambient, nature sounds), and "Meditation" (binaural beats, Tibetan bowls,
guided meditation soundscapes). Each track links to YouTube for streaming. Users can
add their own music recommendations with titles, artists, YouTube URLs, and categories.
The app tracks most played tracks and suggests music based on current mood - uplifting
music when sad, calming music when anxious.
Crisis Resources: A prominent section provides immediate access to crisis helplines
(suicide prevention, mental health emergency lines), texting services, and resources for
users in acute distress. This section is always accessible regardless of subscription status,
reflecting the app's commitment to mental health safety.

AI Diet Plan Generator: This feature creates personalized meal plans based on
comprehensive user profiles. Users input their health goals (weight loss, weight gain,
muscle building, disease management, general health), dietary preferences (vegetarian,
non-vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, keto, paleo), health conditions (diabetes, hypertension,
kidney disease, PCOS, thyroid disorders), allergies and intolerances, age, weight, height,
activity level, and target timeline. The AI generates a detailed weekly meal plan with
breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks for 7 days. Each meal includes dish names,
ingredients with quantities, cooking instructions, macronutrient breakdown (calories,
protein, carbs, fats), micronutrients (vitamins, minerals), and health benefits. The plan
considers cultural food preferences (Indian, Western, Asian cuisines) and seasons.
Food Information Search: Users can search any food item by name to get comprehensive
nutritional information. The AI retrieves data including calorie count per serving,

macronutrients (protein, carbs, fats, fiber), micronutrients (vitamins A/C/D/E/K, calcium,
iron, potassium, etc.), health rating (1-10 scale based on nutrient density), health benefits
(what makes it good), potential concerns (high sugar, sodium, allergens), recommended
serving sizes, best times to eat, and food pairings that enhance nutrient absorption. The
interface displays this in an organized card format with visual indicators for nutritional
values.
Food Image Analysis (AI Vision): Users photograph any food item, and AI analyzes the
image to identify the food, estimate portion size, calculate approximate calories and
macronutrients, provide health rating, list ingredients likely present, and suggest healthier
alternatives. This is perfect for restaurant meals, packaged foods, or home-cooked dishes.

achieving high accuracy for common foods. Results include disclaimers about estimation
accuracy.
Meal Timing Recommendations: Based on the user's goals and health conditions, the AI
suggests optimal meal timing (e.g., "Eat dinner 3 hours before sleep for better digestion" or
"Have protein within 30 minutes post-workout for muscle recovery"). It also warns about
food-medication interactions (e.g., "Avoid grapefruit 2 hours before/after medication X").

food intolerances, allergies, or unexplained digestive issues. Users log every meal with

AI Pattern Analysis Engine: The true power emerges when users have logged 5+ meals

occurrences.
Elimination Diet Plans: When a sensitivity is suspected, the AI generates a structured

brands, offers meal ideas without the trigger, and warns about nutritional gaps to address
with supplements or other foods.
Reintroduction Protocols: After elimination, the app guides users through systematic
reintroduction. It provides a step-by-step plan to reintroduce the food in small amounts,
specifies observation periods and symptoms to watch for, explains how to interpret results,
and determines if the food can be safely reintroduced or must be permanently avoided.
This scientific approach prevents unnecessary long-term restrictions.
Medication Recommendations: For confirmed sensitivities, the app suggests both
over-the-counter and prescription medications that can help manage symptoms. For
digestive issues: lactase supplements for lactose intolerance, digestive enzymes,
probiotics, antacids, anti-bloating medications. For allergies: antihistamines, topical
creams. Each recommendation includes dosage, timing, purpose, and safety warnings.

medications.
Natural Remedies: Alternative treatment options are provided, including herbal teas
(ginger for nausea, peppermint for bloating), supplements (probiotics for gut health,

quercetin for histamine issues), dietary additions (fermented foods, bone broth), and
lifestyle modifications (eating slowly, food combining rules, stress management).

experiencing current symptoms to get immediate personalized advice without historical
data. Users select symptoms they're experiencing right now, rate severity, indicate
duration, list suspected trigger foods, provide medical history (optional), list current
medications, note dietary restrictions, enter age and weight, and specify dietary
preference. The AI then generates customized advice including immediate relief
medications (OTC and prescription options with dosages and purposes), natural remedies
with usage instructions, foods to avoid right now with reasons, hydration and lifestyle tips,
and red flags indicating when to see a doctor immediately. This feature is like having a
nutritionist and gastroenterologist in your pocket.
Progress Tracking & Insights: A dedicated insights tab shows total meals logged,

severity over time), and pro tips for effective tracking. Users can export their complete food

test") or concerning trends ("Your vitamin D has been declining over 6 months"). This
visual trend data is invaluable for managing chronic conditions.

what the test measures, why doctors order it, what normal ranges indicate, what causes
high/low values, and what symptoms are associated with abnormal results. This patient
education reduces anxiety and improves health literacy.
Doctor & Lab Information: Reports store the ordering doctor's name and the laboratory that
performed the tests, helping users maintain complete medical records and track which
doctors ordered which tests.
Family Lab History: Similar to document scanning, lab reports can be associated with
specific family members, allowing parents to track children's health or adult children to
manage elderly parents' care.
n Emergency Profile (Premium)
Digital Health Card: The Emergency Profile is a potentially life-saving feature that compiles
all critical medical information into one accessible place. It's designed for first responders,
emergency room staff, or good Samaritans to quickly access vital health information when
the user is unconscious or unable to communicate.
Core Medical Information: Users input blood type (A+, A-, B+, B-, AB+, AB-, O+, O-,
unknown), comprehensive list of allergies (medications, foods, environmental), chronic
conditions (diabetes, heart disease, asthma, epilepsy, etc.), current medications with
dosages, and special medical notes (implanted devices like pacemakers, recent surgeries,

DNR status, etc.).
Emergency Contacts System: Users add multiple emergency contacts with name,
relationship (spouse, parent, sibling, friend), and phone number. The system allows
ranking contacts by priority. During an emergency, these contacts can be called directly
from the profile with one tap. The app can also send automated SMS alerts to all
emergency contacts with the user's GPS location.
Primary Doctor Information: The profile stores the user's primary care physician's details
including name, specialty, phone number, and clinic/hospital affiliation. This allows
emergency personnel to contact the doctor for medical history or treatment guidance.
Insurance Details: Users store insurance provider name and policy number, ensuring this
critical information is available during hospital admissions. This prevents delays in
emergency care due to missing insurance information.
Organ Donor Status: A clear yes/no indicator shows if the user has registered as an organ
donor, honoring their wishes in worst-case scenarios.
QR Code Generation: The app generates a unique QR code encoding all the emergency
profile information. Users can screenshot this QR code and set it as their phone's lock
screen wallpaper, add it to a phone case, print it on a medical alert bracelet, or carry it as a
laminated card. When scanned by anyone with a QR code reader, the code displays the
complete emergency profile in a universally readable format (works even if they don't have
the app). This is a revolutionary feature that makes medical information accessible in
seconds during critical moments.
Quick Access Lock Screen Widget: The profile can be accessed from the phone's lock
screen without unlocking, ensuring it's available even if the user is unconscious and the
phone is locked. A special bypass allows anyone to tap an "Emergency Info" button on the
lock screen.
Automatic Updates: When users update medications, conditions, or emergency contacts
elsewhere in the app, the emergency profile automatically syncs these changes. The QR
code updates too, though users need to regenerate and replace physical copies.
Multi-Language Support: The emergency profile displays in both English and Hindi (or
other selected regional languages), ensuring information is accessible to all healthcare

providers in India.

their entire family from one account. Users add family members by entering name,
relationship to user (self, spouse, child, parent, sibling, grandparent, other), date of birth
(age auto-calculated), gender, blood type, and optionally a photo. The interface displays
family members as colorful cards with relationship-based color coding (spouses in pink,
children in blue, parents in green, etc.).
Individual Health Records: Each family member has a complete, separate health profile
including their own allergies list, chronic conditions, current medications, vaccination
records with dates and next due dates, medical document storage, lab report history, and
symptom logs. This is particularly valuable for parents managing children's health or adult
children caring for aging parents.
Shared Calendar: Appointments for all family members appear in a shared family health
calendar with color coding by person. This prevents scheduling conflicts and ensures no
one misses important doctor visits. Users can filter the calendar to show only one family
member or the entire family.

polio, hepatitis, flu shots, etc.) with dates administered and automatically calculates next
due dates based on CDC/Indian immunization schedules. Push notifications remind
parents when vaccinations are due, preventing missed immunizations.
Growth & Development Tracking: For pediatric family members, the app can track height,
weight, and BMI over time, plotting growth curves and comparing against standard
pediatric growth charts. Parents can see if their child's growth is on track.

ensuring they receive medicine on time even when multiple family members need
medications at different times. The app prevents confusion about who needs what
medicine when.
Emergency Profiles for All: Each family member gets their own emergency profile and QR
code, so children, elderly parents, or spouses with medical conditions have their critical

information accessible during emergencies.

users don't need to re-enter pediatricians, specialists, or therapists for each family
member. Providers can be tagged by which family members they treat.
Privacy & Access Control: Users can set up secondary logins for other family members
(e.g., spouse, older children) to allow them access to relevant health information while
maintaining privacy boundaries. Children's profiles can be transferred to them when they
become adults.

running in the family, seasonal illness trends affecting multiple members, or shared dietary
issues. This helps users make informed health decisions for the entire family.
nn Premium Subscription System

(medications, appointments, symptom checker, dashboard, mental health basics,
document scanning, lab reports viewing) are free forever. Premium features (Food
Sensitivity Tracker, Medication Image ID, Emergency Profile QR codes, Family Health
Management) require a one-time payment of n300.
Admin Privileges: The app recognizes two user roles: "admin" and "user". Admin users
(typically the app owner/developer) automatically have premium access for free, bypassing
the payment requirement. This allows testing and demonstration of premium features
without charges. Regular users with "user" role must pay to unlock premium.
Razorpay Payment Integration: The payment system uses Razorpay, India's leading
payment gateway, supporting all payment methods (credit/debit cards, net banking, UPI,
wallets like Paytm/PhonePe/Google Pay, and international cards). When users click "Pay
n300 via Razorpay," a secure Razorpay checkout modal opens. Users complete payment
within the modal without leaving the app. Upon successful payment, Razorpay returns a
payment ID (razorpay_payment_id), which the app stores along with premium_status =
'active' and premium_activated_date. Premium features unlock instantly - no manual
verification needed.
Payment Security: Razorpay is PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant, meaning it meets the highest

security standards for handling payment data. The app never sees or stores users' card
details - all sensitive data stays with Razorpay. Transactions use TLS/SSL encryption.
Lifetime Access: The n300 payment is one-time only, granting lifetime premium access.
There are no recurring charges, subscriptions, or hidden fees. This pricing strategy makes
the premium tier affordable while ensuring long-term revenue.
Premium Feature Gating: The app uses a PremiumGate component that wraps premium
features. When non-premium users try accessing gated features, they see a beautiful
upgrade screen explaining the feature's value and a prominent "Upgrade to Premium -
n300" button linking to the payment page. The gate checks user.premium_status ===
'active' || user.role === 'admin' to determine access.
Transaction Tracking: Every payment is logged with transaction ID, payment date, and
user email. This audit trail helps with customer support inquiries, refunds (if needed), and
analytics on subscription conversion rates.
Refund Policy: While not explicitly in the UI, the payment system supports Razorpay's
refund API, allowing manual refunds if users encounter issues or are unsatisfied within a
reasonable timeframe.
n Multi-Language Support
English & Hindi Interface: The entire app supports both English and Hindi (Devanagari
script), India's two most widely spoken languages. A language toggle button appears in the
sidebar navigation, allowing instant switching. All UI text, labels, buttons, messages, and
navigation items translate dynamically. The app stores language preference in local
storage, persisting across sessions.
Language Context System: The implementation uses React Context API to provide
translation functions throughout the component tree. A LanguageContext component
wraps the app, and any component can access the t() (translate) function via
useLanguage() hook. Translation keys map to English/Hindi text pairs. For example,
t('dashboard') returns "Dashboard" in English or "nnnnnnnn" in Hindi.

built to support RTL languages like Arabic or Urdu if expanded in the future. The layout
system uses logical CSS properties (start/end instead of left/right) to facilitate RTL

adaptation.

example, meal preferences in diet plans include Indian vegetarian options (paneer, dal,
roti) rather than assuming Western diets. Medical terminology is explained in simple Hindi
for users more comfortable with regional language.

descriptions) remains in the language the user wrote it in, but system-generated AI
responses respect the current language setting. If a Hindi-speaking user asks the AI
companion a question, responses come in Hindi.

languages (Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi, etc.) by simply adding translation files, making
the app accessible to India's linguistically diverse population.
n Component Architecture
Glass-Morphism Design System: The app extensively uses a custom GlassCard
component that creates the signature frosted glass effect. Cards have backdrop-blur-xl for
blur, bg-white/10 for semi-transparent white backgrounds, border border-white/20 for
subtle borders, and rounded-3xl for soft corners. A subtle white gradient at the top edge
adds depth. All content sits inside GlassCards for visual consistency.
Framer Motion Animations: Every card uses Framer Motion's motion.div for entrance
animations ( initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} , animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} ), hover effects (
whileHover={{ y: -4 }} ), and smooth transitions. Loading states use animated spinners,
and page transitions slide smoothly.
Responsive Grid Layouts: The app uses Tailwind's responsive grid system ( grid
md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 ) throughout. On mobile (default), cards stack vertically. On
tablets (md breakpoint), 2-column grids appear. On desktops (lg breakpoint), 3-column
grids maximize screen space. All touch targets exceed 44x44px for accessibility.
Reusable UI Components: The app leverages Shadcn/UI component library, which
provides beautifully designed, accessible components like buttons, inputs, dialogs, tabs,
accordions, selects, and more. These components are pre-styled to match the app's
aesthetic and are keyboard-navigable for accessibility.

Icon System: All icons come from Lucide React, a beautiful open-source icon library with
over 1000 icons. Icons are used consistently (Pill for medications, Calendar for
appointments, Brain for AI features, Heart for mental health, etc.), creating visual language
that aids navigation.
Modal Dialogs: Forms for adding data (new medication, new appointment, etc.) open in
modal dialogs using Shadcn's Dialog component. Modals dim the background, center the
form, and trap focus for better UX. They're dismissible via X button, Escape key, or clicking
outside.

(Shadcn Tabs) to organize sub-features without cluttering the screen. Active tabs are
highlighted, and content smoothly transitions when switching tabs.
n Security & Privacy
Row-Level Security (RLS): Every data entity has RLS rules ensuring users can only
access their own data. The created_by field automatically populates with the user's email,
and read/update/delete operations check created_by === user.email . This prevents data
breaches where users might accidentally access others' health records.
Admin vs User Roles: The User entity has a role field (admin/user). Admins have broader
permissions (can invite users, access premium for free) while regular users have restricted
access. Role-based access control prevents privilege escalation.
Authentication: The app uses Base44's built-in authentication system, which handles user
registration, email verification, password security (bcrypt hashing), and session
management. Login is required to access the app, with automatic redirects to login pages
for unauthenticated users.
Data Encryption: All data transfers use HTTPS/TLS encryption. Sensitive health data
stored in the database is encrypted at rest. API keys and secrets are stored in
environment variables, never hard-coded.
HIPAA Considerations: While not formally HIPAA-certified (would require infrastructure
audits), the app follows HIPAA's privacy principles: minimum necessary data collection,
audit trails (created_date/updated_date on all records), user access control, and data
integrity measures.

Privacy Disclaimer: The app includes disclaimers throughout that it's a personal health
tracking tool, not a medical device or official health record system. Users are reminded
that AI advice doesn't replace professional medical care.

via React Query (@tanstack/react-query) for server state and useState/useContext for

color palette. Tailwind Merge and Class Variance Authority for conditional styling.

components. Lucide React for icons. Framer Motion for animations.

operations), file storage, and integrations API without custom backend code.
AI Integration: OpenAI-compatible LLM via Base44's Core.InvokeLLM integration. Can add
internet context for real-time data fetching (OpenFDA, health databases, etc.).
Maps: React-Leaflet for interactive maps. OpenStreetMap tiles for map data. Geolocation
API for user location.
Date Handling: Date-fns for date formatting and manipulation. React-Day-Picker for
calendar UI.
Forms: React-Hook-Form for form state management and validation. Zod for schema
validation.
Payments: Razorpay SDK for payment processing.
Routing: React Router Dom for client-side routing and navigation.
Rich Text: React-Quill for rich text editing (journal entries, notes).
Data Visualization: Recharts for health score graphs, mood trends, chronic condition

charts.

n What is Swasthya Sathi?
Swasthya Sathi (meaning "Health Companion" in Hindi) is a comprehensive AI-powered
telehealth and personal health management platform built for Indian users. It bridges the
gap between patients and healthcare by putting smart health tools directly in the hands of
users — in both English and Hindi .
n Core Purpose
The app serves as a one-stop digital health companion that helps individuals:
• Monitor and manage their health proactively
• Connect with doctors and book appointments
• Track medications and chronic conditions
• Access emergency services quickly
• Manage the health of their entire family — all from one platform
n Key Features & Their Uses
1. n AI Symptom Checker
What it does: Users enter their symptoms, duration, and severity. An AI analyzes them and
provides:
• Possible conditions
• Urgency level (low / medium / high / emergency)
• Self-care tips and recommendations
• History of past symptom checks

Use: Helps users understand when to see a doctor vs. manage at home, reducing
unnecessary hospital visits.
2. n Appointments
What it does: Full appointment management system including:
• AI-powered doctor matching based on symptoms
• Nearby hospital/clinic finder using GPS
• Route calculation to the selected facility
• Appointment booking with date, time, reason
• Medical history timeline of past consultations
• Video consultation via Jitsi links
Use: Simplifies the entire process of finding, booking, and attending doctor appointments
— online or in-person.
3. n Medication Manager
What it does:
• Track active prescriptions with dosage and frequency
• AI drug information lookup
• Medication interaction checker
• Side effect logging
• Expiry and refill alerts
• AI-powered medicine identification from photos (OCR)
• Dose adherence logging
Use: Ensures patients never miss a dose, stay safe from drug interactions, and manage
their prescriptions efficiently.
4. n Mental Health Hub
What it does:
• Daily mood tracking with journal entries
• AI companion chatbot for emotional support
• Curated wellness exercises based on mood
• Personal music library (YouTube-based) with categories like calming, meditation,

high-energy
• Crisis support resources
Use: Addresses mental wellness holistically — tracking patterns, offering support, and
providing calming resources.
5. n Food & Nutrition Tracker
What it does:
• AI-generated personalized 7-day meal plans
• Nutritional information lookup for any food
• Food image analysis using AI vision
• Meal logging with symptom tracking after eating
Use: Helps users eat healthier and discover how their diet impacts their physical
symptoms.

• Logs meals and tracks post-meal symptoms
• AI identifies patterns linking specific foods to symptoms
• Manages elimination/reintroduction plans
